notes.title: Power & Revolution 2019 Edition available
notes.content:
The new [i][b]Power & Revolution 2019 Edition[/b][/i] game is available on Steam! 
If you already own the [i][b]Power & Revolution[/b][/i] game, get a big discount on the price by buying the Bundle [i][b]"Power & Revolution + Power & Revolution 2019 Edition"[/b][/i] 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10382/_Power__Revolution__2019_Edition_Bundle/
 and also benefit from the price reduction during the first week launch.

Additional information; if you already own DLCs of the [i][b]Power & Revolution[/b][/i] game (God'n Spy, Modding Tool, 2018 Edition, 2017 Edition), they will automatically be taken into account and still active in your new [i][b]Power & Revolution 2019 Edition[/b][/i] game.

notes.title: Release of the 2018 Edition of Power & Revolution
notes.content:
With the 2018 add-on, you can participate in the conquest of space and try to be the first to set foot on Martian soil,  battle cybercrime and use it to cripple your enemies, administer justice to the roster of terrorists to thwart attacks and step in to prevent World War Three by overthrowing the American president and neutralizing North Korea.

DLC page
http://store.steampowered.com/app/783910/

Gel more on the official website
http://www.power-and-revolution.com/news.php

notes.content:

notes.title: 2017 Edition DLC released on Inauguration Day!
notes.content:
Washingthon DC, Jan 20, 2017 : Donald Trump enters the Oval Office!

With the 2017 Edition, try out the political agenda of the new US President! Will it be viable?
Engage in conflicts mapped-out for 2017! Will this year see the end of conflict in Syria and Iraq?
